headline: Biman Bangladesh Airlines resumes flights to Riyadh from Oct 25
summary: Flights to Dammam are also resuming from Wednesday, providing relief to thousands of passengers affected by previous restrictions.
details: Biman Bangladesh Airlines will operate a flight from Dhaka to Riyadh on October 25, following improvements in the security situation at Saudi Arabian airports.
The Riyadh-bound flight is scheduled to depart from Dhaka at 1:25 AM on October 25.
The airline has stated that the decision to operate further Riyadh-bound flights will be based on a continuous review of the overall situation.
Flights to Dammam will resume from October 26, with daily flights departing Dhaka at 8:00 AM using Boeing 777 aircraft.
Additionally, la flights will depart for Jeddah on October 23, 24, and 25 at 7:20 PM, with two daily flights starting from October 26.
Flights to Madinah, which have been operating since October 18 using Boeing 787 aircraft, will continue their current schedule without changes.
caption:
Flights to Riyadh and Dammam are back! Biman Bangladesh Airlines is resuming services to Saudi Arabia.

Biman Bangladesh Airlines will operate a flight from Dhaka to Riyadh on October 25, following improvements in the security situation at Saudi Arabian airports.

The Riyadh-bound flight is scheduled to depart from Dhaka at 1:25 AM on October 25.

The airline has stated that the decision to operate further Riyadh-bound flights will be based on a continuous review of the overall situation.

Flights to Dammam will resume from October 26, with daily flights departing Dhaka at 8:00 AM using Boeing 777 aircraft.

Additionally, la flights will depart for Jeddah on October 23, 24, and 25 at 7:20 PM, with two daily flights starting from October 26.

Flights to Madinah, which have been operating since October 18 using Boeing 787 aircraft, will continue their current schedule without changes.

headline_marked: 3 carriages of Karnaphuli Commuter [[derail in Cumilla]], suspending Dhaka-Chattogram route
headline: 3 carriages of Karnaphuli Commuter derail in Cumilla, suspending Dhaka-Chattogram route
summary: The derailment occurred in Laksam upazila around 12:30 pm today, causing partial damage to the railway track and suspending movement on the up line.
details: Three carriages of the Dhaka-bound Karnaphuli Commuter train derailed in the Azgara area of Cumilla's Laksam upazila around 12:30 pm today.
The incident has suspended train movement on the up line of the Dhaka-Chattogram railway route, while services on the down line remain operational.
Rajib Chandra Kar, officer-in-charge of Laksam Railway Police Station, confirmed that the derailment also partially damaged the railway track.
Local sources report that the train was travelling from Chattogram to Dhaka when the carriages derailed while passing through Azgara.
No casualties were immediately reported, although several passengers sustained minor injuries.
A railway rescue team has been dispatched to the scene to recover the derailed carriages and recover the track.
Railway authorities stated that train services will resume normally once the recovery operation is completed.
caption:
3 carriages of the Karnaphuli Commuter derailed in Cumilla today, suspending movement on the Dhaka-Chattogram route.

Three carriages of the Dhaka-bound Karnaphuli Commuter train derailed in the Azgara area of Cumilla's Laksam upazila around 12:30 pm today.

The incident has suspended train movement on the up line of the Dhaka-Chattogram railway route, while services on the down line remain operational.

Rajib Chandra Kar, officer-in-charge of Laksam Railway Police Station, confirmed that the derailment also partially damaged the railway track.

Local sources report that the train was travelling from Chattogram to Dhaka when the carriages derailed while passing through Azgara.

No casualties were immediately reported, although several passengers sustained minor injuries.

A railway rescue team has been dispatched to the scene to recover the derailed carriages and recover the track.

Railway authorities stated that train services will resume normally once the recovery operation is completed.
